key_insight: QYANTRAM makes quantum compilation, verification, error identification, and model training transparent and independently checkable.
engineering_relevance: Traceable compilation and exact active-qubit verification help engineers audit quantum workflows on large hardware layouts.
method: Expose compilation stages, routing scores, and rejected SWAP candidates.
Verify only k active qubits when inactive qubits remain in |0>, reducing state-space complexity from 2^N to 2^k.
Exhaustively evaluate Pauli error patterns and validate model-training numerics against Qiskit.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports sub-millisecond pre-compilation verification on 127- and 156-qubit layouts with approximately 10,000× speed-ups, error predictions agreeing within 2.8e-17, and training 25–50× faster with numerical agreement within 2.0e-15.
watch_item: Routing omits optimization and uses approximately 1.27× as many SWAP gates as Qiskit's SABRE, trading efficiency for transparency.
paper_title: Qyantram: A Transparent and Verifiable Quantum Computing Platform
